'''Brethupp''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Ewok/Legends|Ewok]] who lived in [[Bright Tree Village/Legends|Bright Tree Village]] on the [[Endor/Legends|forest moon]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Endor (planet)/Legends|Endor]]. He was present in the village when a group of captured [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebels]] was brought back by a hunting party, and watched in the village square as they were prepared for cooking in honor of [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]], a Rebel [[Droid/Legends|droid]] the Ewoks believed to be a [[Deity/Legends|god]]. Brethupp was then amongst the Ewoks who rushed to free the Rebels after C-3PO demonstrated his powers by levitating, although in truth the apparent miracle was caused by the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]], one of the captured Rebels. Following Bright Tree village's alliance with the Rebels in a [[Battle of Endor/Legends|battle]] against [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] forces on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]], Brethupp attended a celebration of the Empire's defeat.

==Biography==
The [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Ewok/Legends|Ewok]] Brethupp lived in [[Bright Tree Village/Legends|Bright Tree Village]] on the [[Endor/Legends|forest moon]] of [[Endor (planet)/Legends|Endor]]. In the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]], an [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] [[Endor strike team/Legends|strike force]] arrived on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] with the aim of destroying an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Endor shield generator bunker|shield generator bunker]] which protected the unfinished [[Death Star II/Legends|Death Star II]] [[Space station/Legends|battle station]] in orbit. A group of these Rebels was captured, however, by a hunting party from Bright Tree village who mistook [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]], a [[Droid/Legends|droid]] member of the group, for the [[Deity/Legends|deity]]<ref name="rotj" /> known as the [[Golden One/Legends|Golden One]].
[[File:Brethupp_drumming.png|thumb|left|Brethupp played a makeshift drum set after the Battle of Endor|200px]]
The Ewoks brought the droid and his companions home, at which point the village's [[Shaman/Legends|shaman]], [[Logray/Legends|Logray]], ordered that the other members of the captured group&mdash;[[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]], [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]], [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]] and [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]]&mdash;be served as part of a banquet in the Golden One's honor. Brethupp was amongst the Ewoks who gathered in Bright Tree village square to witness the captives' preparation for consumption and watched as first [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]], another Rebel whom the Ewoks had found, and then C-3PO himself attempted to persuade Logray to spare their friends. The shaman remained unconvinced even when C-3PO threatened to use his magic, but quickly ordered that the prisoners be freed when the droid levitated into the air, a trick carried out by the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] Skywalker using [[The Force/Legends|the Force]]. Brethupp was amongst those Ewoks that rushed to free the prisoners on Logray's orders.<ref name="rotj" />

The Ewoks were eventually persuaded by the Rebels to aid them in [[Battle of Endor/Legends|destroying]] the Imperial shield generator, which the two forces successfully did, allowing for the destruction of the Death Star in the skies above the moon. Following the joint victory, Rebels and Ewoks alike celebrated in Bright Tree Village. Brethupp attended the celebration, where he played a [[Drum/Legends|drum]] set fashioned out of the [[Armor/Legends|armor]] of Imperial troopers.<ref name="rotj" />

==Personality and traits==
Brethupp had [[Color/Legends|gray]] and white fur.<ref name="rotj" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|Brethupp is an easy one since he has spotted fur and can be seen in the village square. He's also one of the Ewok drummers during the festivities.|Tim Veekhoven clarifies where Brethupp appears in the film|<ref name="YY" />}}
[[File:Kiran_Shah_with_Brethupp_costume.jpg|250px|thumb|[[Kiran Shah]] in Brethupp costume]]
Brethupp first appeared in the [[1983]] film [[Star Wars: Episode VI Return of the Jedi|''Star Wars'': Episode VI ''Return of the Jedi'']], where he was played by [[Kiran Shah]]<ref name="CNN">{{WebCite|url=https://www.cnn.com/style/article/kiran-shah-profile-spc-intl/index.html|text=Kiran Shah: The hero with a thousand faces|work=CNN Style|archivedate=20220909052738}}</ref> but the character name was not identified. He would remain unidentified until [[2012]], when [[Leland Chee]] revealed his name in the ''[[Star Wars Insider]]'' [[Star Wars Insider 135|135]] [[Rogues Gallery (department)|''Rogues Gallery'']] article ''Ewoks: Warriors of Endor''. In the [[2014]] [[Star Wars Blog]] post ''[[Yub Yub: Meet the Ewoks from Endor]]'', [[Tim Veekhoven]] described where Brethupp could be seen in the film and also revealed his gender.
